trace.scope: Instrumented diagnostic only. Stage wall/CPU totals sum across threads and overlap when nested. CPU excludes blocking/descheduling but not clock overhead. CPU clocks cover session/block/worker/voice and late stages. room-trace disables inner arithmetic-stage clocks entirely; room-profile alone retains inner stage wall times. Waiting for other workers is not evidence of OS preemption. Capacity requires a separate unprofiled run.
